reviewKind: Manual source inspection with read-only hashes, test-discovery review and whitespace; no runtime or compilation

checks.invariant: Complete endpoint coverage including remote support changes
checks.basis: No edit-region filter; compare every material/thermal/mechanical/constraint coordinate and every global M5 support distance/load/capacity/reaction

checks.invariant: No implicit physics or global solve during commit
checks.basis: Commit creates a lazy changes method capturing private original endpoints; only explicit inspection calls the observer; existing solver/schedule sources are unchanged

checks.invariant: Bounds overflow never masquerades as complete empty changes
checks.basis: Collectors count and extend bounds before checking budget; overflow empties incomplete runs and sets requiresFullRead; shared remaining counter is never replenished

checks.invariant: Queries do not modify authoritative state
checks.basis: Observer inputs use isolated snapshots and anchor overlays; proposed physical state discarded; copies of report stamps; synchronous reentrancy guard restored in finally

checks.invariant: Temperature and energy are distinguished using existing integer thermal law
checks.basis: temperatureQ is compared independently of conserved energy and packed thermal byte; no thermal or phase rules rewritten

checks.invariant: Endpoints are not promoted to trajectories
checks.basis: scope endpoints and motion not-observed require an execution trace even for identical endpoints

checks.invariant: Real global support fixtures remain excluded from authorized mock testing
checks.basis: Mock file traps real step and solve; real cases use runtime-cases.ts filename outside ordinary *.test.ts discovery and a separate explicit held config

findingsAddressed: Avoid per-changed-cell coordinate-vector allocations in bounds collection
Validate first support observation before requesting the second
Do not recycle overflowed run capacity or expose truncated lists
Keep report generation explicit so commit does not gain hidden global work
notProven: Compiler/type/lint validity or authored test assertions
Actual bridge support report correctness under the real solver
Physical replay, per-tick changes or actual fragment correspondence
GPU reporting, responsiveness, latency or frame benchmarks
